description.p: A fullscreen GTK4/libadwaita home screen for the Nuxel phone platform. Displays a status bar with time, network, battery, and notification indicators, along with a launcher grid of PWA and native apps.
Supports drag-to-reorder apps, tap-to-launch PWAs via Chromium, and native-placeholder stubs for future built-in apps.

Nuxel Home v0.7.4-beta — aligned with Nuxel Phone OS v0.7.4-beta (owner-confirmed speaker audio, working network location, truthful native/Flatpak application entries, and the PWNAGE-44000 Home and hardware-control pass).

ul.li: Speaker audio works: CS35L41 PLL/driver-cache fix plus the 8 s inaudible warm-up
Network location works through a per-UID GeoClue agent; satellite GNSS stays BLOCKED_FIRMWARE
Long-press drag/reorder with pointer-cancel rollback
Sticky Notes widget, 15-entry power menu, screenshot into Gallery
Server-side Gallery thumbnails, Bluetooth Files Send, single-owner flashlight
Location, sound-mode and USB status cells with a charging-only battery bolt
Launcher cache v66-v074-release, registry revision 8 and whole-repo v0.7.4-beta bump
